source.title: Achievements in Implementing the Strategic Action Programme in the Philippines during 2008-2021
source.project: Implementing the Strategic Action Programme for the South China Sea and Gulf of Thailand
source.meeting: First Meeting of the Regional Scientific and Technical Committee, Bangkok, 17-19 October 2022
source.retrieval: Official 13-page project PDF reviewed through its indexed text; no local copy retained.

findings.namedSite: The evaluation names Pansipit River Estuary as a coastal-wetland site; this corroborates a named research lead but does not delimit its reach.

planningContext.sourceReported: The report describes a 15 ha Pansipit River Estuary site in the SCS SAP management-plan target context and says Pansipit Estuary had no existing management plan at that evaluation point.
planningContext.interpretation: Historical project-planning context only. It does not establish the wetted estuary area, current plan status, legal boundary, or present protection rules. The underlying plan and map were not verified.

findings.fishEvidence: The reviewed management evaluation provides no estuary-specific fish survey results or species list. Separate Pansipit River studies and 1933 river-locality specimens do not establish an estuary-specific station or reach; no crosswalk is available.
findings.salinity: No season-specific salinity values or estuary-specific salinity classification appear in the reviewed evaluation.
findings.geometry: No physical water boundary, station coordinates, or GIS geometry is provided.

nextAction: Locate the current Taal Volcano Protected Landscape/estuary management plan, the underlying site-selection dataset and maps, plus dated biological monitoring results with station coordinates and salinity. Keep estuary fish coverage, boundaries and salinity unresolved until reviewed.
